title: High Fibre Foods in India: Fibre per 100 g in Dals, Millets, Fruits and Vegetables (ICMR-NIN Data)
seoTitle: High Fiber Foods: Indian Foods Ranked by Fibre per 100 g
seoDescription: Top high-fibre Indian foods: kala chana, rajma, whole moong, bajra, ragi, atta, guava, amla and alsi, with NIN fibre values and daily needs.
excerpt: A table of 26 everyday Indian foods with total, soluble and insoluble fibre from NIN's food composition tables, a sample day that crosses 30 g, safe ways to add fibre and when to check with a doctor first.
